items.t: ABS light from a failing brake control module
items.job: Replace or rebuild ABS electronic brake control module (EBCM)
items.note: Mail-in rebuilt modules cost less than a new one. Includes setup programming at most shops.

items.t: Gauge needles sticking or reading wrong
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster (replace gauge stepper motors)
items.note: Mail-in rebuild services are the usual fix and cost less than a new cluster. Expect a few days of downtime.

items.t: Ignition lock can bind (recall)
items.note: Free under GM's ignition lock recall. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: Cylinder deactivation lifter failure
items.note: Caught early, some shops replace only the failed bank's lifters. If the engine is badly damaged, a replacement engine costs much more.

items.t: Shudder from the 8-speed automatic
items.job: Full transmission fluid exchange with updated ATF (per bulletin)
items.note: If the fluid exchange does not cure it, a torque converter replacement costs much more.

items.t: Magnetic Ride shocks leaking
items.note: Price is per shock. GM's bulletin says to replace only the failed shock, not pairs.

items.t: A/C condenser leaking refrigerant
items.job: Replace A/C condenser, evacuate and recharge
items.note: GM special coverage covers some VINs for 6 years or 72,000 miles. Check your VIN with a dealer first.

items.t: Reduced brake assist from vacuum pump (recall)
items.job: Replace engine vacuum pump and update brake module software
items.note: The recall reprograms the brake module for free. Check your VIN. A failed pump may still need replacing.

items.t: 6.2L rod and crankshaft defect (recall)
items.job: Replace engine (6.2L V8) after failed recall inspection
items.note: Free under GM's L87 recall. Engines that pass inspection get an oil change and new oil only. Check your VIN.

items.t: Center screen going black
items.job: Reset and reprogram video processing module
items.note: Usually a software fix per GM bulletin. If the module itself has failed, replacing it costs more.

items.t: Rear wheels can lock up (recall)
items.note: Free software update under GM's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: Transfer case missing part (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect transfer case and replace it if needed
items.note: Free under GM's do-not-drive recall. Check your VIN and have it towed to the dealer.

items.t: Battery cable can rub on the steering shaft (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 02V-224. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering and brake pedal suddenly get heavy (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 04V-045. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering hose can split (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 05V-455. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Heated washer fluid module can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 08V-441. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump control module lets water in (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 09V-154. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear axle can lock up (recall)
items.job: Inspect rear differential and replace cross pin
items.note: Free under recall 11V-007. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Shifter can move out of Park on its own (recall)
items.job: Replace park lock cable or steering column lock parts
items.note: Free under recall 13V-001. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Chassis control module can short out (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 14V-614. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out and snaps back (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 18V-586. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front airbags may not deploy (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-651. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front upper control arm weld can fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front upper control arms
items.note: Free under recall 16V-256. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump built without a pressure regulator (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 19V-837. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump power module can quit (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump power control module
items.note: Free under recall 21V-739. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear driveshaft can break (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-036. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Diesel models may have the wrong fuel tank (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-619. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear control arm bolts can snap (recall)
items.job: Replace rear control arm bolts and align
items.note: Free under recall 23V-642. Check the VIN first.

items.t: No warning when brake fluid is low (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-674. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front wheel hub bolts can loosen (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-304. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Lifter failure on the cylinder-deactivation V8
items.note: Many shops replace all lifters and the cam together and delete or disable cylinder deactivation.

items.t: Automatic can lose third and fourth gear
items.job: Rebuild or replace the 4L60-E automatic transmission
items.note: Price swings with rebuild versus reman unit and whether the torque converter is replaced.

items.t: Harsh bang on the shift from first to second
items.job: Replace the transmission valve body and gaskets

items.t: Security light on with a stall or no start
items.job: Replace the Passlock sensor and relearn the system

items.t: ABS cycles on by itself at low speed
items.job: Replace a front wheel speed sensor or hub bearing assembly
items.note: Per side; the sensor is built into the hub assembly on many of these trucks.
